title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR prep & renewals
content:
Daily scratchpad - high level plan and quick notes

Date: 2026-06-12
Owner: Zoe Hart
Focus: QBR prep for top accounts + renewals follow-ups + clearing high-priority support tickets

Top priorities today:
- QBR prep: NovaHealth (2026-06-20) - finalize slides and runbook. Need latest usage slides (latency, token consumption, active users), 30-day trend, and a short list of wins.
  - Action: pull usage dashboard + cost breakdown (ask eng/observability) - @Priya to export per-route token breakdown by EOD.
  - Talking points: 20% latency improvement after model switch; caching reduced token spend by ~12%; adoption up 18% MoM. Confirm numbers.
- Renewal at-risk: Acme Corp (renewal 2026-07-15) - CSAT dropped after recent latency spike.
  - Action: schedule technical review with SRE and account engineering (send invites).
  - Open tickets: JIRA-CS-4521 (latency spike) still open, escalated to eng; need ETA and mitigation plan to present to customer.
- Renewal on-track: BrightMart (renewal 2026-07-01) - sales engaged, waiting for legal redlines. Check with deal owner (Sam) for timeline.

Support follow-ups:
- JIRA-CS-4599: embeddings mismatch for search rerank - triage notes in ticket, assigned to Priya. Request small reproduction dataset from customer.
- JIRA-CS-4605: streaming disconnects for long polls - SRE investigating; current workaround = reduce keepalive interval. Notify customers on status page if fix ETA >48h.

QBR slide TOC (draft):
1) Exec summary: 3 bullets (value delivered, risks, asks)
2) Usage & trends (30/90 day) - tokens, API calls, active devs
3) Performance metrics - latency P50/P95, errors, cold-starts
4) Cost & optimization opportunities - batching/caching wins, potential quantization recommendation
5) Support/incident review - recent tickets and remediation status
6) Roadmap alignment & asks (features we need from them: data for evals, access to staging, SLA expectations)

Quick notes / items to collect:
- Latest token spend per route (hosted-api) - from Observability console (Priya)
- Example prompt set + failing cases for embeddings mismatch (request from customer)
- Deployment timeline for upcoming kernel optimizations (ask Serving Runtime PM)

People to ping today:
- @Priya Natarajan - per-route cost export; embeddings ticket update
- @Liam O'Connor - schedule SRE call for Acme; confirm availability 6/16-6/18
- @Sam Lee (sales) - BrightMart legal redline status
- @Ellen (Solutions Eng) - prepare short demo of new caching behavior for NovaHealth

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we have a short-term mitigation for Acme latency (fallback to smaller model?) - need SRE input
- Can we produce a simple ROI calc for BrightMart renewal? Which metric sales wants shown? (ARR impact vs cost savings)

Misc todo today (quick):
- [ ] Export NovaHealth usage graphs (Priya)
- [ ] Draft QBR slide 1-3 (me)
- [ ] Email Acme stakeholders re: technical review (send calendar + pre-read)
- [ ] Follow up on JIRA-CS-4521 for ETA (Liam)
- [ ] Post short status note to #cs-qbr Slack channel after noon sync

Notes to self:
- Keep QBR slides concise (<=10 slides). Customer wants concrete outcomes and next steps.
- Bring up cost optimization options but frame as recommendations with tradeoffs.
- For renewals, always surface concrete commercial ask (discount vs feature delivery timeline).

End of scratchpad.
